verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community user noting that Trello's card back has enough comment space that "you could have a real discussion on the back of the card." That points to native, card-scoped threaded discussion rather than team chat. The Slack/email capture into the Inbox (trello-docs-1) is an integration that pulls content in, not chat inside Trello, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-app messaging or comments, real-time or direct team chat beyond per-card comments, mentions and notifications, and hands-on corroboration of conversation workflows.
